title: Software Engineer
description: Designs, builds and maintains software applications and systems.
roadmap: Learn a language deeply (Python, Java or JavaScript)
Study data structures and algorithms
Build 3-5 real projects and publish them on GitHub
Learn Git, databases (SQL) and basic system design
Do internships or contribute to open source
Prepare for coding interviews and apply

title: Data Scientist
description: Extracts insights from data using statistics, programming and machine learning.
roadmap: Master Python, pandas and SQL
Learn statistics and probability
Study machine learning (scikit-learn), then deep learning
Complete end-to-end projects on Kaggle datasets
Learn data visualisation and storytelling
Build a portfolio and apply for analyst / junior DS roles

title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer
description: Builds and deploys machine learning models and AI-powered products.
roadmap: Get strong in Python, linear algebra and calculus
Learn classical ML, then deep learning (PyTorch)
Study LLMs, NLP and computer vision basics
Learn MLOps: model serving, Docker, cloud
Ship AI projects with real users
Apply for ML engineer roles or pursue a master's

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Protects organisations' systems and data from cyber threats.
roadmap: Learn networking (TCP/IP) and operating systems (Linux)
Study security fundamentals and get CompTIA Security+
Practise on TryHackMe / HackTheBox legal labs
Learn scripting (Python, Bash)
Get certifications like CEH or OSCP
Apply for SOC analyst roles

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Designs digital products that are easy and enjoyable to use.
roadmap: Learn design principles (typography, colour, layout)
Master Figma
Study user research and usability testing
Redesign 3 existing apps as case studies
Build a portfolio website
Apply for internships / junior designer roles

title: Graphic Designer
description: Creates visual content for brands, media and marketing.
roadmap: Learn design fundamentals
Master Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or Canva/Figma
Practise daily design challenges
Build a Behance / Dribbble portfolio
Freelance for small clients
Apply to agencies or in-house design teams

title: Doctor (MBBS)
description: Diagnoses and treats illnesses to keep people healthy.
roadmap: Take PCB (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) in 11th/12th
Crack NEET-UG
Complete MBBS (5.5 years incl. internship)
Prepare for NEET-PG for specialisation
Complete MD/MS residency
Practise in a hospital or start a clinic

title: Nurse
description: Provides patient care and supports doctors in hospitals and clinics.
roadmap: Take biology in 11th/12th
Complete GNM diploma or B.Sc Nursing
Register with the State Nursing Council
Gain hospital experience
Specialise (ICU, paediatrics, etc.) or study further

title: Pharmacist
description: Prepares and dispenses medicines and advises patients on their use.
roadmap: Take PCB or PCM in 11th/12th
Complete D.Pharm or B.Pharm
Register with the Pharmacy Council
Work in hospital, retail or pharma industry
Consider M.Pharm for research roles

title: Psychologist / Counsellor
description: Helps people understand and improve their mental health and behaviour.
roadmap: Complete BA/B.Sc in Psychology
Do an MA/M.Sc in Clinical or Counselling Psychology
Complete supervised practice hours
Get an M.Phil / RCI licence for clinical practice
Work in clinics, schools, NGOs or start a practice

title: Teacher / Educator
description: Educates and mentors students in schools or colleges.
roadmap: Complete a bachelor's degree in your favourite subject
Complete a B.Ed
Clear CTET / state TET (or UGC-NET for college lecturers)
Gain teaching experience via tutoring
Apply to schools / colleges

title: Chartered Accountant
description: Manages audits, taxation and financial reporting for businesses.
roadmap: Take commerce in 11th/12th
Register for CA Foundation with ICAI
Clear CA Intermediate
Complete 3 years of articleship
Clear CA Final
Join a firm or start practice

title: Financial Analyst
description: Analyses financial data to guide investment and business decisions.
roadmap: Complete B.Com / BBA / Economics
Master Excel and financial modelling
Learn valuation and accounting basics
Pursue CFA Level 1 or an MBA in Finance
Intern at a bank, fund or corporate finance team

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description: Promotes brands and products through online channels.
roadmap: Learn SEO, social media and content marketing
Get Google Ads & Analytics certifications
Run campaigns for your own blog or a small business
Learn basic data analysis
Apply to agencies or startups

title: Entrepreneur
description: Starts and grows a business by solving problems people will pay for.
roadmap: Find a problem you understand well
Talk to potential customers
Build a minimum viable product
Get first paying customers
Learn finance, sales and hiring
Seek incubators / funding (Startup India, accelerators)

title: Lawyer
description: Advises and represents clients in legal matters.
roadmap: Crack CLAT / AILET after 12th (5-year integrated LLB)
Or complete graduation then a 3-year LLB
Do internships with advocates and law firms
Clear the All India Bar Examination
Choose a field: corporate, criminal, civil, etc.

title: Civil Servant (IAS/IPS)
description: Administers government policy and public services.
roadmap: Complete any bachelor's degree
Read newspapers and NCERTs regularly
Prepare for UPSC Prelims, Mains and Interview
Choose an optional subject wisely
Practise answer writing and mock tests

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Designs and manufactures machines, engines and mechanical systems.
roadmap: Take PCM in 11th/12th
Crack JEE or state entrance exams
Complete B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
Learn CAD tools (SolidWorks, AutoCAD)
Do internships in manufacturing / automotive
Consider GATE for PSU jobs or M.Tech

title: Civil Engineer
description: Plans and builds infrastructure such as roads, bridges and buildings.
roadmap: Take PCM in 11th/12th
Complete B.Tech / diploma in Civil Engineering
Learn AutoCAD, STAAD Pro and estimation
Get site experience through internships
Clear GATE / state engineering service exams for government jobs

title: Architect
description: Designs buildings and spaces that are functional and beautiful.
roadmap: Take PCM in 11th/12th
Clear NATA or JEE Paper 2
Complete the 5-year B.Arch
Register with the Council of Architecture
Work with a firm, then start your own practice

title: Journalist / Content Writer
description: Researches, writes and reports stories for news and digital media.
roadmap: Read widely and write daily (start a blog)
Study journalism / mass communication or English
Build a portfolio of published articles
Intern at a newspaper, magazine or digital outlet
Specialise in a beat (tech, sports, politics, etc.)

title: Video Editor / Content Creator
description: Creates and edits videos for social media, films and brands.
roadmap: Learn editing tools (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut)
Study storytelling and pacing
Publish consistently on YouTube / Instagram
Build a showreel
Freelance or join a media agency

title: Chef
description: Creates dishes and runs kitchens in restaurants and hotels.
roadmap: Cook regularly and learn cuisines
Join a hotel management / culinary course (NCHMCT JEE)
Train in a professional kitchen
Work up from commis chef to sous chef
Specialise or open your own outlet

title: Sports Coach / Fitness Trainer
description: Trains athletes and individuals to improve performance and fitness.
roadmap: Play and train in your chosen sport
Get a certification (ACE, NSCA, or NIS coaching diploma)
Study sports science and nutrition basics
Assist experienced coaches
Build a client base or join an academy
resources: Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports

title: Environmental Scientist
description: Studies the environment and finds solutions to problems like pollution and climate change.
roadmap: Take science in 11th/12th
Complete B.Sc in Environmental Science / Biology / Chemistry
Complete an M.Sc in Environmental Science
Learn GIS and data analysis
Work with NGOs, government bodies or consultancies
